author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time I want to take a look at some alarming things said by Jeff Bezos a bit closer. Computers and by extension "compute" is something that these people consider should one day only happen behind subscriptions. Don't give in because letting them control our access to computers is how losing everything truly begins. Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: They Don't Want You To Own Computers...
